prose: TestingCatalog covers OpenAI's Images 2.6 launch: global rollout in ChatGPT and Codex on all tiers, with GIF creation and reusable reference images, so you can save yourself or a pet once and reuse them. GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst arrive in the API, generating 50% faster, with Sunburst keeping edits more consistent at medium or high quality. OpenAI says usage has reached 4 billion images a week.
highlights: Images 2.6 on all ChatGPT tiers and Codex
